comment: Provenance record for the captured CLI fixtures (INFRA-2e). Every fixture in this directory was captured from a REAL claude CLI run; the panel's protocol tests replay these bytes, so when the CLI is upgraded the captures must be re-taken and this record updated. Re-capture procedure: docs/design-notes/2026-08-23-phase2-batch-e-access-and-coverage.md. Exact per-file capture dates were not recorded at capture time (the files predate this record); capturedEra bounds them via the research/design-note timeline.
capturedEra: 2026-07 to 2026-08 (protocol research phase; see docs/research/02-claude-cli-protocol.md and 02b/02c)

auth_login_stdout.txt.source: live capture, claude auth login stdout

init_plugins.json.source: live capture 2026-09-10 on claude 2.1.267 (NOT the 2.1.218 era): system/init of a spawn using the panel's exact argument list with Unity's official plugin installed -- plugins[] carries one entry {name, path, source, version}; docs/verify/2026-09-10-unity-plugin-verification-report.md section 1

session_usage_disk.jsonl.source: live capture, on-disk transcript with usage records

subagent_sidechain.meta.json.source: live capture, the CLI's sidecar metadata written next to the sidechain transcript (agentType/toolUseId)

subagent_toolresult_disk.jsonl.source: live capture, subagent tool_result on-disk form

terminal_session_disk.jsonl.source: hand-authored (MODEL-6 canary), modeled line-for-line on a real CLI terminal-session transcript observed 2026-08-23: bare-string user content carrying <command-name>/<command-message>/<command-args> wrappers plus <local-command-stdout> and <local-command-caveat> blocks. NOT a byte capture -- it pins the panel's PARSING of that format; if the CLI changes the wrapper tags, TranscriptLoaderTests' canary assertions fail and this file must be re-modeled.
